description: Unoptimized AM11 chord transmission — degraded, noisy, distant

notes.why_AM: AM has no capture effect — noise adds linearly to the envelope, degrading the chord
notes.why_low_power: 5 W at 400 km yields massive Friis path loss; signal barely above noise floor
notes.why_high_freq: 800 MHz carrier increases FSPL by ~18 dB vs 100 MHz (FSPL ~ 20·log10(f))
notes.why_8000_sr: Downsampling from 44.1k to 8k destroys upper harmonics of the chord voicing
notes.why_low_mod_index: 0.3 mod index means only 30% modulation depth — demodulated signal is weak
notes.why_multipath: 2-ray multipath causes comb filtering: notches in the spectrum distort chord timbre
notes.why_high_noise_floor: -60 dBm is a very noisy receiver environment (urban RF interference)
